"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"People who love America can change it.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Abraham Lincoln, Susan B. Anthony, Martin Luther King Jr., Cesar Chavez, and Rosa Parks believed their country could be a better place and worked to make it so.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"This Party has made the biggest difference in the lives of the American people when it summoned the entire nation to a common purpose.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"There is a choice to stay on the current failed course.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"There is a choice to build upon the best of who and what America is and reflect its highest values.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"America can rise together and create a new kind of government.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The time for change has come, and America must seize it.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
